messages:
carla: RC ready — build 2026.03.21-rc7 pushed. release notes https://redwood.internal/rc/rc7. Small DB migration present but guarded behind feature flag. Need ops + SRE signoff before promotion. Artifact SHA: c3f8b9e2. Pin request for deploy control: `rc=2026.03.21-rc7`

alex: I ran quick smoke, embedding-service returned a few 503s for ~30s during load but recovered. Investigating shard balance; not seeing persistent OOMs.

maria: QA ran chat E2E smoke. One failing case on very long prompts (>10k tokens) — filed bug #342. It's synthetic only.

chris: @maria is that exercise seen in prod traffic? if not we can proceed with constrained canary.

maria: not in prod. only stress harness. propose canary with 10% traffic, KV-warm, and disable long-prompt routing for the slice.

carla: plan: start 10% canary in us-west, 20m KV warm, monitor p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, and our quality evals. Rollback criteria: p95 latency increases by >2s OR error rate >0.5% OR new eval BLEU drop >3 pts. Manual rollback command for ops: `deploy-bot rollback rc=2026.03.21-rc7 --target all`

deploy-bot: preflight OK — artifacts verified (c3f8b9e2). Migrations present but feature-flagged. Canary window default 30m. Creating canary slice now.

alex: I'll own oncall watch this window. tagging @sre-oncall for overnight coverage.

sre-oncall: ack — I'll spin up a short dashboard with latency, error rate, KV misses, and model downscales. Alert thresholds set to the rollback criteria.

carla: ops note for after promo: pin control-plane runtime: `rwctl pin model-generation 1.13.0-rc7` and keep 1.12.9 in fallback pool. Also leave migration flag off until post-validated.

maria: recommend running post-promo batch eval: promptset `rc_smoke_v2` against 1k production-like samples.

chris: adding feature-flag `enable_rc7_mig` default=off. we'll flip only after green post-promo checks.

deploy-bot: canary started — slice id 0x7e9. targets us-west-1. traffic 10% -> monitoring for 30m. Live metrics snapshot: p95=1.10s, errors=0.03%. KV misses low.

alex: looks clean so far. proceeding to bump to 25% after KV warm completes.

deploy-bot: KV-warm complete. traffic bumped to 25%. Canary window extended to 60m for extra evals.

maria: QA ran rc_smoke_v2 at 25% — no quality regressions observed. Filing final checklist: docs updated, release-notes linked, runbook annotated. OK for promo slot at 02:00 UTC.

carla: final signoff from: @alex, @maria, @sre-oncall. I'm giving go for promo at 02:00 UTC. Promotion window pinned 02:00-03:00 UTC. Reminder: use runbook rollback if thresholds breach and avoid flipping migration flag until post-promo.

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled for 02:00 UTC. Notifying on-call rotation and CI/CD scheduler.

chris: leaving quick rollback snippet for runbook: `kubectl set image deployment/serve model=rw/model:1.12.9 && timeout 300 bash -c "until curl -sf http://localhost/health; do sleep 5; done"` — saved in ops-runbook.

carla: thanks team :rocket: Let’s reconvene if any alerts show up during the window.
file_notes: RC origination + signoff thread: dep tree, QA, canary, KV-warm, pin, rollback criteria
